name: Skinny Start

pitch_detail.notes: Broken terrain leads to an obvious splitter through a clean panel; climbs solid granite splitters and left-facing corners.
Trends left into a right-facing corner system.
Joins the Kearney-Thomas line, finishing via its 5.11 finger-crack variation.

descent_text: The standard descent is the Beckey-Tate walk-down (scramble to the notch, then the loose gully back to the Hairpin pullout). Rappelling the Beckey-Tate line itself is the other option, but at least one party was unable to find a rappel anchor along the top of that line and instead had to change into rock shoes and make a high traverse to a saddle before descending — budget extra time and be prepared to build your own anchors.
approach: Same south-face approach as Kearney-Thomas/Beckey-Tate: park at the Hairpin pullout on SR-20, follow the Kangaroo Temple/Wallaby Peak path along Early Winters Creek, cross the creek, and ascend the approach gully (left fork at the high Y-junction) to the base of the south face, then locate the start about 30 meters right of the standard Kearney-Thomas start.
overview: A harder direct start to the Kearney-Thomas route, climbing clean splitters and left-facing corners about 30 meters right of the original start before rejoining the Kearney-Thomas line for its finishing 5.11 finger-crack pitch.
beta: Located 30 meters right of the Kearney-Thomas start, this variation climbs solid granite splitters and left-facing corners (5.10+) before trending left into a right-facing corner, then joins the Kearney-Thomas line and finishes via a 5.11 finger-crack variation.
